title: Supplementary code and verification harness for: Weak-measurement reconstruction of the conditional momentum field for atomic matter waves: a dispersive photon-curtain protocol following Kocsis–Steinberg (NJP-120031)
description: Complete Python source that generates Figures 2-5 and every simulation- or formula-derived number of the manuscript, the verification harness (verify_p7_master.py, 179 checks) that re-derives each quoted number and checks it against the manuscript text, the small result files needed to reproduce the figures, and the official Fig-4 data anchor. See README.md and LOCAL_RUN_GUIDE.md.
